reason: The README clearly describes a browser UI plugin that adds a vertical message index for navigating and tracking positions within long DeepSeek Harness conversations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面添加消息导航条，可通过标记快速定位消息并随滚动高亮当前位置。
summaries.en: Adds a message navigation strip to the DeepSeek Harness web chat interface for jumping between messages and highlighting the current reading position.

capabilities: Adds a navigation overlay to the chat interface
Scrolls the conversation to selected messages
Tracks scrolling and dynamically updates message markers
